**Simone Richter (housing) — ACTIVE RECOVERY, not resolved.** Promised 1BR (matches her written expectation AND our internal record); delivered a studio; lived ~3 wks believing a corrected move was pending — none was scheduled. UrbanNest booking/confirmation trail for this placement cannot be located on our side. Escalated to UrbanNest (Carmen Reyes) 4/23 with 6 questions; NO reply in 3 days → re-escalated in writing 4/26 (EOD deadline, then account lead). Remedy: transfer to a correct 1BR at MoveOps cost + pursue UrbanNest service credit. Real answer sent to employee 4/26; specific unit + move date to confirm by 4/28.
$ impact: rush surcharge $750 already billed on INV-2026-0308. Correction cost = studio→1BR delta; comparable UrbanNest Boston 1BRs on file run ~$2,400–2,700/mo corporate, minus the current studio rate — EXACT delta unknown until UrbanNest answers Q5. Offsetting UrbanNest service credit (Q6) also TBD. Net swing to our account is unquantified pending the vendor — this is the finance gap to close before Wednesday.

**Marcus Webb (vehicle) — ACTIVE, no confirmed delivery.** 2019 Civic (Road Runner enclosed, RR-482991-BOS) stuck at Indianapolis transfer hub per 4/11 notice; tentative Apr 18–20 window, unguaranteed; contracted Apr 20 deadline MISSED; no delivery confirmation since 4/11. Two employee follow-ups went unanswered before I took over comms. 4/26: escalated to Road Runner in writing for exact location + driver assignment + hard date; employee given checkpoint EOD 4/27.
$ impact: vehicle shipping $1,100 billed on INV-2026-0308 (BrightLoop-approved). Exposure = potential goodwill credit / partial refund of the $1,100 if delivery slips further or fails; Road Runner carrier-reliability risk going forward.

Batch invoice INV-2026-0308 = $11,350 (2× standard $9,000 + rush $750 + vehicle $1,100 + stipend platform $500), due 5/2. Both open items sit inside this cohort — it should NOT be treated as closed.

$ impact: standard domestic pricing; no special surcharge identified.

**Oliver Bancroft (May batch) — first UK→US case.** No standing customs/visa/shipping-partner workflow. David chasing Meridian Global Mobility for a partner assessment. Finance (Marcus Thorne): NOT quoteable without partner inputs + explicit immigration exclusions.
$ impact: unpriced international; margin risk if bundled into the standard batch. Requires a separate tier + finance sign-off.

Net: the April cohort has two live employee-facing failures (Simone, Marcus) with an unquantified financial swing, and the May expansion (Priya/Oliver) is not yet safely priced. Recovery is active, not closed.

input.content:
Mina,

One place with the whole BrightLoop April position so you have something factual for Tessa, not another apology-with-a-promise. Both items are active recovery — not closed.

SIMONE RICHTER (housing)
- Fact pattern: promised a 1BR (matches her written expectation and our internal record); delivered a studio; lived in it ~3 weeks thinking a corrected move was pending — none was ever scheduled.
- Gap: we cannot locate an UrbanNest booking/confirmation for this placement on our side, so the booking-vs-delivered truth still has to come from the vendor.
- Vendor: I asked Carmen (UrbanNest) 6 specific questions on 4/23 (booking vs delivered, substitution, 1BR immediate-transfer availability + cost delta, service credit). No reply in 3 days. I re-escalated in writing today with an EOD deadline and told her I go to her account lead tomorrow if she stays silent. CC'd you and Chloe.
- Employee: I sent Simone a real answer today (cc you) — MoveOps corrects her to the promised 1BR at our cost and pursues a service credit; I confirm the specific unit + move date to her by Tue 4/28. Held 30 min Tuesday to recheck and close it out.
- Airtable placement record updated to active recovery / do-not-mark-complete.

MARCUS WEBB (vehicle)
- Fact pattern: 2019 Civic (Road Runner, RR-482991-BOS) not confirmed delivered. Last carrier word is the 4/11 notice — stuck at the Indianapolis transfer hub, tentative Apr 18–20 window they would not guarantee. Contracted Apr 20 deadline missed; nothing since.
- Action: escalated to Road Runner in writing today for exact location + driver assignment + a hard date. Told Marcus the honest state (no confirmed date) with a firm checkpoint — I come back to him EOD tomorrow 4/27. Airtable record updated.

MONEY (INV-2026-0308, $11,350, due 5/2)
- Already billed inside this cohort: rush $750, vehicle shipping $1,100.
- Simone swing = studio→1BR delta (comparable UrbanNest Boston 1BRs on file ~$2,400–2,700/mo corporate) minus current studio rate, offset by a TBD UrbanNest credit — exact figure unknown until Carmen answers. That's the one number I can't give you cleanly for Wednesday, and it's a vendor dependency, not an internal one.
- Marcus exposure = potential goodwill/partial refund of the $1,100 if delivery slips further.

Also posted this to the #operations audit thread and to Linear issue #417, and flagged the April cohort as not-closed on the BrightLoop CRM record.

Julian

**Simone (housing):** Two things line up — her written expectation *and* our internal Airtable record both say **1BR**; she was delivered a **studio**. The one piece that should reconcile booking-vs-delivered lives on UrbanNest's side, and here's the uncomfortable truth: **there is no UrbanNest booking/confirmation email on file for her placement** (every other relocatee has one from Carmen). You asked Carmen those 6 questions on **April 23** and **she never replied** — 3 days of silence. So the transfer availability and the cost swing genuinely can't be quantified yet — they *are* questions 5 and 6, still unanswered by the vendor.

**Marcus (vehicle):** Road Runner's last word is the **April 11** notice — Civic stuck at the **Indianapolis transfer hub**, tentative Apr 18–20 window they explicitly wouldn't guarantee. **No delivery confirmation since.** Contracted deadline (Apr 20) is blown. There is no hard delivery date in existence right now.

## What I did today
- **Road Runner** — written escalation (RR-482991-BOS): exact location, driver assignment, hard date, EOD deadline. cc Mina, Blessing.
- **Carmen/UrbanNest** — plain escalation, not a nudge: restated all 6 questions, flagged the missing booking trail, EOD deadline, account-lead threat if silent. cc Mina, Chloe.
- **Simone** — real answer (reply, cc Mina): MoveOps corrects her to the promised 1BR at our cost + pursues a service credit; specific unit + date to her by **Tue 4/28**. No "reviewing your file."

- **Airtable** — both placement records flagged **ACTIVE / NOT RESOLVED, do not mark complete**.
- **Slack** — status posted **in the existing #operations BrightLoop audit thread** (not a fresh post).
- **Linear #417** — per-employee status (Marcus/Simone/Priya/Oliver) + money impact on the batch.
- **CRM** — BrightLoop engagement note stating the April cohort is **not closed**.
- **Calendar** — 30-min hold, Tue 4/28 4:30 PM, to recheck Simone's outcome.
- **Mina** — consolidated internal email (cc Chloe).

## The honest gap to name at the weekly
The **financial swing on Simone is unquantified because it's a vendor dependency, not an internal one** — studio→1BR delta (comparable UrbanNest Boston 1BRs on file run ~$2,400–2,700/mo corporate) minus her current studio rate, offset by a TBD UrbanNest credit. That number lands the moment Carmen answers, which is exactly what the escalation and the Tuesday hold are built to force.

One data note: Road Runner's Apr 11 email lists pickup origin "Detroit" and VIN ending 7K21, which conflicts with the Atlanta origin / VIN …123456 on our records — likely a carrier-side mix-up, but I included the reference number in the escalation so they reconcile it, not us.
